subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes the sentence in the simple present: Naman is the only one of the researchers who _____ the tribal dialect, while his colleagues _____ on an interpreter.
explanation: 'The only one ... who' singles out one person, so 'understands' is required. The separate plural subject 'colleagues' takes 'rely'.
explanation_pa: 'The only one ... who' ਨਾਲ ਇੱਕ ਹੀ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'understands' ਆਵੇਗੀ। ਵੱਖਰੇ plural subject 'colleagues' ਨਾਲ 'rely' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: The stationery supplied to this branch _____ suitable for archival use.
explanation: Stationery is an uncountable noun and takes singular 'is'. Its reference to several writing materials does not make it grammatically plural.
explanation_pa: 'Stationery' ਇੱਕ uncountable noun ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ singular verb 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ। ਇਸ ਦਾ ਅਰਥ ਲਿਖਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਕਈ ਚੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ ਇਹ grammar ਅਨੁਸਾਰ plural ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Neither the warden nor the hostel residents _____ visitors after the prescribed hour.
explanation: With 'neither...nor', agreement follows the nearer subject, plural 'residents'. Hence 'entertain' is correct despite the singular first subject.
explanation_pa: 'neither...nor' ਨਾਲ verb ਆਪਣੇ ਨੇੜਲੇ subject ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਇੱਥੇ plural 'residents' ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ ਪਹਿਲਾ subject singular ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ 'entertain' ਸਹੀ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: The surgeon, as well as the anaesthetists, _____ the patient's medical history before the operation.
explanation: An 'as well as' phrase does not change the number of the main subject. Singular 'surgeon' therefore takes 'examines'.
explanation_pa: 'as well as' ਵਾਲਾ phrase ਮੁੱਖ subject ਦਾ number ਨਹੀਂ ਬਦਲਦਾ। ਇਸ ਲਈ singular 'surgeon' ਨਾਲ 'examines' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: 'Great Expectations' _____ prominently in the literature section of this reading programme.
explanation: The title denotes one novel and takes singular 'features'. The plural form of 'Expectations' within the title does not control agreement.
explanation_pa: ਇਹ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਇੱਕ ਹੀ ਨਾਵਲ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ singular verb 'features' ਆਵੇਗੀ। ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵਿੱਚ 'Expectations' ਦਾ plural ਰੂਪ verb ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਤੈਅ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Using British English collective-noun agreement, choose the pair that matches the stated meanings in the simple present: The committee, acting unanimously as one body, _____ the revised policy; the jury, divided among themselves, _____ incompatible interpretations of the testimony.
explanation: A collective noun viewed as a unit takes singular 'endorses'. When the members are explicitly divided, British English uses plural agreement, giving 'offer'.
explanation_pa: ਜਦੋਂ collective noun ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਇਕਾਈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਾਵੇ, ਤਾਂ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ singular verb 'endorses' ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਜਦੋਂ ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਵਿਚਲਾ ਮਤਭੇਦ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਹੋਵੇ, ਤਾਂ British English ਵਿੱਚ plural verb ਵਰਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'offer' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: A pair of pliers _____ useful for gripping the damaged wire.
explanation: The head noun 'pair' is singular and requires 'is'. Pliers takes a plural verb only when it is itself the head of the subject.
explanation_pa: ਮੁੱਖ noun 'pair' singular ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ। 'Pliers' ਨਾਲ plural verb ਤਦੋਂ ਹੀ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਜਦੋਂ ਇਹ ਖ਼ੁਦ subject ਦਾ ਮੁੱਖ noun ਹੋਵੇ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: One of the lifts in the administrative block _____ directly to the basement.
explanation: The subject is singular 'one', which takes 'goes'. Plural 'lifts' belongs to the following phrase and does not determine the verb.
explanation_pa: subject singular 'one' ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ 'goes' ਆਵੇਗੀ। plural 'lifts' ਅੱਗੇ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ phrase ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ verb ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਤੈਅ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes the sentence in the simple present: What the beneficiaries need most _____ reliable transport, and the vehicles which serve the remote hamlets _____ frequent repairs.
explanation: The subject clause 'What the beneficiaries need most' takes singular 'is' before the uncountable complement 'transport'. Plural 'vehicles' takes 'require' in the second clause.
explanation_pa: subject clause 'What the beneficiaries need most' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ uncountable complement 'transport' ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ singular verb 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ। ਦੂਜੇ clause ਵਿੱਚ plural 'vehicles' ਨਾਲ 'require' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes the sentence in the simple present: Every male and female contestant _____ an individual locker, but the male and female contestants together _____ a common rehearsal room.
explanation: 'Every' makes 'male and female contestant' distributive and singular, requiring 'has'. The explicitly plural subject 'contestants' in the second clause requires 'share'.
explanation_pa: 'Every' ਕਾਰਨ 'male and female contestant' ਵਿੱਚ ਹਰੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਯੋਗੀ ਦੀ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ ਗੱਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ subject singular ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'has' ਆਵੇਗੀ। ਦੂਜੇ clause ਵਿੱਚ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ plural subject 'contestants' ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'share' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes the sentence in the simple present: The number of unresolved appeals _____ small, but a number of appellants _____ dissatisfied with the procedure.
explanation: 'The number of' takes singular 'is', whereas 'a number of' means several and takes plural 'remain'. The similar wording conceals different agreement patterns.
explanation_pa: 'The number of' ਨਾਲ singular verb 'is' ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਦਕਿ 'a number of' ਦਾ ਅਰਥ ਕਈ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ plural verb 'remain' ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਸ਼ਬਦ ਮਿਲਦੇ-ਜੁਲਦੇ ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ ਦੋਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ subject-verb agreement ਵੱਖਰੀ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: The treasurer, in addition to the elected trustees, _____ a copy of the annual audit report.
explanation: 'In addition to' introduces a supplementary phrase and does not create a plural subject. Singular 'treasurer' therefore requires 'receives'.
explanation_pa: 'In addition to' ਨਾਲ ਵਾਧੂ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ phrase ਜੁੜਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰ subject plural ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਦਾ। ਇਸ ਲਈ singular 'treasurer' ਨਾਲ 'receives' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Either the translators or the editor _____ the final wording of the bilingual notice.
explanation: With 'either...or', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. Singular 'editor' requires 'approves', despite the plural first subject.
explanation_pa: 'either...or' ਨਾਲ verb ਆਪਣੇ ਨੇੜਲੇ subject ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ ਪਹਿਲਾ subject plural ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ ਨੇੜਲੇ singular subject 'editor' ਨਾਲ 'approves' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Every application for a duplicate certificate _____ a recent photograph.
explanation: 'Every' followed by a singular noun takes a singular verb, so 'requires' is correct. The reference to multiple applications does not permit 'require'.
explanation_pa: 'Every' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ singular noun ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'requires' ਸਹੀ ਹੈ। ਕਈ ਅਰਜ਼ੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਹੋਣ ਨਾਲ 'require' ਵਰਤਣਾ ਸਹੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: None of the evidence presented during the inquiry _____ the allegation of forgery.
explanation: 'None of' followed by uncountable 'evidence' takes a singular verb, giving 'supports'. The negative meaning of 'none' does not require plural agreement.
explanation_pa: 'None of' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ uncountable noun 'evidence' ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ singular verb 'supports' ਆਵੇਗੀ। 'none' ਦਾ ਅਰਥ ਨਾਂਹ-ਵਾਚਕ ਹੋਣ ਕਾਰਨ plural verb ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈਂਦੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: The injured _____ immediate assistance after any major industrial accident.
explanation: 'The injured' refers to injured people and takes a plural verb. Therefore, 'need' is correct, whereas 'needs' wrongly treats the expression as singular.
explanation_pa: 'The injured' ਦਾ ਅਰਥ ਜ਼ਖ਼ਮੀ ਲੋਕ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ plural verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ 'need' ਸਹੀ ਹੈ, ਜਦਕਿ 'needs' ਵਰਤਣ ਨਾਲ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨਾਲ singular ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes the sentence in the simple present: The economist and columnist, who is one person, _____ at this institute; the economist and the columnist, who are two different people, _____ at the neighbouring university.
explanation: Two descriptions joined by 'and' take a singular verb when they identify one person. When they identify two people, as explicitly stated in the second clause, a plural verb is required.
explanation_pa: ਜਦੋਂ 'and' ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ ਦੋ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਹੋਣ, ਤਾਂ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਜਦੋਂ ਉਹ ਦੋ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਆਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਹੋਣ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਦੂਜੇ clause ਵਿੱਚ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ plural verb ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Most of the delegates _____ simultaneous interpretation during the conference.
explanation: With 'most of', the following noun determines agreement. Plural 'delegates' requires 'request'; 'most' does not make the subject singular.
explanation_pa: 'most of' ਨਾਲ ਅੱਗੇ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ noun ਅਨੁਸਾਰ verb ਚੁਣੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। plural 'delegates' ਨਾਲ 'request' ਆਵੇਗੀ; 'most' subject ਨੂੰ singular ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: The spectacles displayed in this cabinet _____ to a renowned freedom fighter.
explanation: Spectacles is grammatically plural and takes 'belong'. A singular verb would require a singular head such as 'a pair'.
explanation_pa: 'Spectacles' grammar ਅਨੁਸਾਰ plural ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ 'belong' ਆਵੇਗੀ। singular verb ਲਈ subject ਦਾ ਮੁੱਖ noun singular ਹੋਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਵੇਂ 'a pair'।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: The pensioners who _____ outside this district must submit the declaration by post.
explanation: 'Who' takes its number from its antecedent, plural 'pensioners'. Therefore, 'reside' is required.
explanation_pa: 'Who' ਦਾ number ਉਸ ਦੇ antecedent ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਇੱਥੇ plural 'pensioners' ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ 'reside' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Many a shopkeeper _____ credit to regular customers during the harvest season.
explanation: 'Many a' takes a singular noun and a singular verb, so 'extends' is required. Its meaning of numerous shopkeepers does not justify 'extend'.
explanation_pa: 'Many a' ਨਾਲ singular noun ਅਤੇ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'extends' ਆਵੇਗੀ। ਭਾਵੇਂ ਇਸ ਦਾ ਅਰਥ ਬਹੁਤ ਸਾਰੇ ਦੁਕਾਨਦਾਰ ਹੈ, ਫਿਰ ਵੀ 'extend' ਵਰਤਣਾ ਸਹੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes the sentence in the simple present: Jaspreet is one of the auditors who _____ discrepancies that _____ unnoticed during routine scrutiny.
explanation: 'Who' refers to plural 'auditors', requiring 'detect'. 'That' refers to plural 'discrepancies', requiring 'pass'; neither relative clause agrees with 'Jaspreet'.
explanation_pa: 'Who' ਦਾ ਸੰਬੰਧ plural 'auditors' ਨਾਲ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'detect' ਆਵੇਗੀ। 'That' ਦਾ ਸੰਬੰਧ plural 'discrepancies' ਨਾਲ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'pass' ਆਵੇਗੀ; ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ relative clause ਦੀ verb 'Jaspreet' ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Twenty minutes _____ sufficient for the preliminary briefing.
explanation: A duration treated as one block of time takes a singular verb. Here, twenty minutes is one allotted period, so 'is' is required.
explanation_pa: ਜਦੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਮਿਆਦ ਨੂੰ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੀ ਇੱਕ ਇਕਾਈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਾਵੇ, ਤਾਂ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇੱਥੇ ਵੀਹ ਮਿੰਟ ਇੱਕ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਸਮਾਂ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: There _____ several spelling errors in the provisional merit list.
explanation: In a 'there' construction, the verb agrees with the following subject. Plural 'several spelling errors' requires 'are'.
explanation_pa: 'there' ਵਾਲੀ ਬਣਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ verb ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ subject ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। plural 'several spelling errors' ਨਾਲ 'are' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes the sentence in the simple present: Three-fourths of the reservoir's capacity _____ reserved for agriculture, while three-fourths of the nearby villages _____ on groundwater.
explanation: Fractional expressions agree with the noun following 'of'. Singular 'capacity' requires 'is', whereas plural 'villages' requires 'depend'.
explanation_pa: ਭਿੰਨ ਦਰਸਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ expressions ਵਿੱਚ verb 'of' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ noun ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। singular 'capacity' ਨਾਲ 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ, ਜਦਕਿ plural 'villages' ਨਾਲ 'depend' ਆਵੇਗੀ।
